purpose: Read-only Pons / Robinhood Chain stock-pair research alerts. No wallet, signing, trading, or recommendation logic.

known_unavailable_signals.realized_wallet_pnl: Not inferred from size or buys. Requires an indexed trade-history source and cost-basis reconstruction.
known_unavailable_signals.unique_buyers: Not available in the Pons public launch feed; requires indexing CurveBuy events.
known_unavailable_signals.fomo_social: Not used until Robinhood Chain/Pons coverage and an exportable, authorized data interface are verified.

alert_policy: Alert only on a new threshold-qualified score; re-alert only if score increases by 10 or more. Every alert prints contracts and states missing wallet-PnL/social signals.
